span.p:
Key Innovation: Multi-Query Attention
Standard: Q,K,V each have 16 heads → KV cache = 16 × seq_len
Gemini: Q has 16 heads, K,V share 1 head → KV cache = 1 × seq_len
Memory savings: 80% for KV cache
